name: [C12] Repair runtime ancestor confirmation after abrupt exit (M)
description:
Repair the remaining R11-03 interruption gap, recorded as R12-01.

### Findings (verbatim)
- High: A process exit after creating a runtime ancestor but before fsyncing its parent leaves an existing, unconfirmed directory. A fresh installed defer retry and exact replay return success without fsyncing that parent. | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:252 | Task: P02-T06/P02-T09 | Found by: coordinator installed crash probe.
[BOB] 🟡 F2: _ensure_directory_chain dropped exist_ok, so a peer creating the same missing runtime ancestor makes defer fail with a bare FileExistsError; the sibling helper paths.ensure_runtime_directory:102 handles that case | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:265 | Task: P02-T06

### Evidence
Review HEAD: 39ecaf4f95c79df6a88c30e4626386a352d1505b. See dev/local/reviews/00004_cycle_12_crash_probe.py and 00004-cycle-12-crash-probe.json. Both injected process exits return 73. Retry/replay return 0 with unchanged authoritative state and one ledger item, but project/new parent fsync is omitted. This is syscall durability evidence and consequent data-loss risk, not observed physical power-loss loss.

### Acceptance
Every quoted finding no longer reproduces. Add a chronological failing installed regression that actually terminates a child before parent fsync, then retries in a fresh process; cover both the first missing ancestor and the configured runtime leaf. Confirm every potentially unconfirmed ancestor entry before successful ledger publication or exact replay. Do not rely on exception cleanup to prove crash recovery. Preserve caught-fsync-error behavior, existing confirmed ancestors, directory identity checks, serialization/sidecar ownership, prospective ledger depth validation, report overlap preservation, complete returned text, state-byte preservation and exactly-once records. All subprocesses must be reaped. Run bounded regression, preservation cases and required full gates. No importer, aliases, provider policy, rollback/abort API, new public knobs, or broad state restructuring. This task is queued only; no implementation is authorized within this review session.

Also preserve safe concurrency when a peer creates the same missing ancestor: verify the resulting directory and confirm its parent, without deleting another writer's directory on a failed sync. Retain a separate installed concurrent-creation regression.
